scene_windows.note: DMD columns [first, last], inclusive, that the DMD-space scenes of vol2/volplay.py light for THIS case position; their rows span "rows" above. clean_A / clean_B: the clean face windows inside planeA_cols / planeB_cols, clear of the rounded corner and the outer edges (curtains, ribbons, ocean, plane_*, fw_ribbon). full_width: every column across the case INCLUDING the rounded corner, which fills the gap between the faces (fw_*). The warp-corrected fwc_* take their columns from the warp map; warp_row_max is a DMD row, not a window: the map rows below it are dropped before the fwc_* planes are fitted (vol2/warp_scan.py clean_map). If the case moves: re-map, re-fit, and re-measure these; no code edit.
scene_windows.source: bench 2026-10-05, case upside down (case_map_tank_v2: face A 544-656, corner 656-684, face B 684-768). Clean windows = vol2/plane_color.py WIN_A / WIN_B, a few columns inside planeA_cols / planeB_cols; full width = vol2/plane_geom.py CASE_COLS (its full-width plane test); warp_row_max = the clean_map cutoff the fwc_* used with the 2026-10-05 warp scan (its rows 1040-1080 dropped). [HEURISTIC: set by hand from the scans, not fitted]
